senses.gloss: ch. same; חס ל־ [God spare him!,] far from him! Targ. Gen. XLIV, 7 (h. text חָלִילָה); a. e.,—
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 44b:7">Kidd. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>וחס ליה לזרעיה וכ׳</he> and far it is from the son of Abba … (Samuel) to have said so; <cite ref="Chullin 111b:15">Ḥull. 111ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חס ליה לא וכ׳</he> far from him! He never did &c.
